title: verifyPlanWorkflow
responsibility: Plans full or entity-scoped verification checks using local repository state and a local impact runtime; it does not restore attached evidence or execute checks.

inputs.name: verifyPlan.options
inputs.description: Optional exact commit, requested base, local impact runtime, per-check timeout, entity scope, and repository root.

outputs.name: verifyPlan
outputs.description: Report-only selected plan; it never restores attached evidence or runs planned checks.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid repository/revision/configuration, HTTP runtime refusal, or entity without scenario coverage.
